The condition is equivalent to finding the maximum number of binary vectors of length \(7\) with pairwise Hamming distance at least \(3\).

By the Hamming bound, for a binary code of length \(7\) and minimum distance \(3\),
\[
|C|\le \frac{2^7}{\binom70+\binom71}=\frac{128}{8}=16.
\]
This bound is attained by the \([7,4,3]\) Hamming code, whose parity-check matrix has as columns all nonzero vectors in \(\mathbb F_2^3\). It has \(2^4=16\) codewords and minimum distance \(3\).

Therefore the maximum number of employees is
\[
\boxed{16}.
\]
